title: 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 2 Thessalonians chapter 3 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3.

questions.question: What does Paul ask the brethren to do for him in 2 Thessalonians 3:1?
questions.explanation: Paul requests prayer in 2 Thessalonians 3:1, asking that the word of the Lord may have free course and be glorified.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:2, from whom does Paul ask to be delivered?
questions.explanation: Paul mentions in 2 Thessalonians 3:2 that they may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men.

questions.question: True or False: The Lord is described as faithful in 2 Thessalonians 3:3.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:3 states that 'the Lord is faithful,' confirming that the statement is true.

questions.question: What does Paul express confidence in regarding the Thessalonians in 2 Thessalonians 3:4?
options: They will do the things commanded
They will not listen to him
questions.correctAnswer: They will do the things commanded
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:4, Paul expresses confidence that they both do and will do the things he commands.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:5, what does the Lord direct their hearts into?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:5 mentions that the Lord will direct their hearts into the love of God.

questions.question: True or False: Paul commands the brethren to associate with every brother who walks disorderly in 2 Thessalonians 3:6.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:6 actually commands them to withdraw from every brother that walketh disorderly.

questions.question: What did Paul and his companions not do among the Thessalonians according to 2 Thessalonians 3:7?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:7, Paul states that they did not behave themselves disorderly among the Thessalonians.

questions.question: True or False: Paul worked night and day so that he would not be chargeable to any of the Thessalonians as stated in 2 Thessalonians 3:8.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:8 confirms that Paul and his companions labored night and day to avoid being a burden.

questions.question: What command did Paul give regarding those who do not work in 2 Thessalonians 3:10?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:10, Paul commands that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:11, what are some among the Thessalonians accused of being?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:11 states that some were walking disorderly and working not at all, but were busybodies.

questions.question: True or False: Paul encourages the brethren to be weary in well-doing in 2 Thessalonians 3:13.
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:13 actually encourages them to not be weary in well-doing.

questions.question: In what manner does Paul suggest to treat someone who does not obey this epistle in 2 Thessalonians 3:14?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:15 advises not to count him as an enemy but to admonish him as a brother.

questions.question: What does Paul pray for in 2 Thessalonians 3:16?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:16 mentions that Paul prays for the Lord of peace to give them peace always by all means.

medium.title: 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What does Paul request the brethren to do for him in 2 Thessalonians 3:1?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:1, Paul specifically asks the brethren to pray for him, that the word of the Lord may have free course and be glorified.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:3, who is faithful and will establish the believers?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:3 states that the Lord is faithful and will establish the believers and keep them from evil.

questions.question: What does 2 Thessalonians 3:10 say about those who do not work?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:10, Paul commands that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

questions.question: In 2 Thessalonians 3:11, what are some described as doing instead of working?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:11 mentions that there are some who are walking disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

questions.question: What does Paul say in 2 Thessalonians 3:12 about those who are disorderly?
options: They should work quietly and eat their own bread
questions.correctAnswer: They should work quietly and eat their own bread
questions.explanation: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:12, Paul commands and exhorts those who are disorderly to work with quietness and eat their own bread.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:5, what does the Lord direct the hearts of the believers into?
options: The love of God and patient waiting for Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The love of God and patient waiting for Christ
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:5 states that the Lord directs the hearts of believers into the love of God and into the patient waiting for Christ.

questions.question: True or False: Paul encourages the brethren not to grow weary in well doing in 2 Thessalonians 3:13.
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:13, Paul encourages the brethren not to be weary in well doing, affirming the importance of persistence in good works.

questions.question: What does Paul mean in 2 Thessalonians 3:6 by commanding the brethren to withdraw from every brother that walketh disorderly?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:6, Paul commands to withdraw from disorderly brothers, implying the need to maintain a standard of behavior while still encouraging correction and love.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:9, why did Paul and his companions choose to work hard?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:9 indicates that Paul and his companions worked hard not to be chargeable to the Thessalonians, setting an example for them.

questions.question: True or False: In 2 Thessalonians 3:14, Paul instructs the believers to have company with anyone who does not obey his word.
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:14, Paul instructs the believers to note the man who does not obey his word and to have no company with him, indicating a call for discipline, not fellowship.

questions.question: What does Paul wish for the Thessalonians in 2 Thessalonians 3:16?
questions.explanation: 2 Thessalonians 3:16 expresses Paul's wish that the Lord of peace gives the Thessalonians peace always by all means.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:15, how should the brethren treat a disobedient brother?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:15, Paul instructs that the disobedient man should not be counted as an enemy but admonished as a brother, emphasizing correction with love.

hard.title: 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3.

questions.question: What does Paul ask the brethren to pray for in 2 Thessalonians 3:1?
options: That the word of the Lord may have free course
That they may be delivered from persecution
questions.correctAnswer: That the word of the Lord may have free course
questions.explanation: Paul requests prayer for the word of the Lord to have free course and be glorified, as mentioned in 2 Thessalonians 3:1.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:2, from whom does Paul seek to be delivered?
questions.explanation: Paul mentions that he seeks to be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men in 2 Thessalonians 3:2.

questions.question: In 2 Thessalonians 3:3, what does Paul affirm about the Lord?
questions.explanation: Paul states that the Lord is faithful and will establish and keep the believers from evil, as noted in 2 Thessalonians 3:3.

questions.question: What command does Paul give regarding those who walk disorderly in 2 Thessalonians 3:6?
questions.explanation: In 2 Thessalonians 3:6, Paul commands believers to withdraw from any brother who walks disorderly.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:10, what did Paul command concerning work?
options: If any will not work, neither should he eat
questions.correctAnswer: If any will not work, neither should he eat
questions.explanation: Paul commanded that if anyone does not work, he should not eat, as stated in 2 Thessalonians 3:10.

questions.question: In 2 Thessalonians 3:13, what encouragement does Paul offer to the brethren?
options: Be not weary in well doing
questions.correctAnswer: Be not weary in well doing
questions.explanation: Paul encourages the brethren not to be weary in well doing, as expressed in 2 Thessalonians 3:13.

questions.question: What should be done if a man does not obey Paul's word, according to 2 Thessalonians 3:14?
options: Note that man and avoid him
questions.correctAnswer: Note that man and avoid him
questions.explanation: Paul instructs that if any man does not obey his word, he should be noted and avoided to bring about shame, as stated in 2 Thessalonians 3:14.

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:15, how should one treat a brother who disobeys?
questions.explanation: Paul advises that one should not count a disobedient brother as an enemy but should admonish him as a brother, as per 2 Thessalonians 3:15.

questions.question: What does Paul ask for in 2 Thessalonians 3:16 regarding peace?
options: That they may have peace sometimes
That the Lord of peace may give peace always
questions.correctAnswer: That the Lord of peace may give peace always
questions.explanation: Paul expresses a wish for the Lord of peace to give peace always by all means in 2 Thessalonians 3:16.

questions.question: What literary device is employed in 2 Thessalonians 3:17 when Paul mentions his salutation?
questions.explanation: The mention of Paul's salutation serves as an inclusio, marking the beginning and end of the letter, as referenced in 2 Thessalonians 3:17.

questions.question: What is the Greek meaning of 'disorderly' as used in 2 Thessalonians 3:6?
questions.explanation: 'Disorderly' in the Greek context suggests a lack of order or proper conduct, as referred to in 2 Thessalonians 3:6.

questions.question: True or False: Paul encourages believers to be weary in well doing in 2 Thessalonians 3:13.
questions.explanation: Paul encourages the opposite: he advises believers not to be weary in well doing in 2 Thessalonians 3:13.

questions.question: True or False: In 2 Thessalonians 3:18, Paul wishes grace upon the believers.
questions.explanation: Paul expresses a wish for the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ to be with all believers in 2 Thessalonians 3:18.

questions.question: Which Old Testament verse echoes the theme of working for one’s sustenance, similar to 2 Thessalonians 3:10?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 10:4 states that diligent hands bring wealth, echoing the theme of work leading to sustenance, similar to 2 Thessalonians 3:10.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage parallels the instruction to admonish those who disobey in 2 Thessalonians 3:15?
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:1 instructs believers to restore those who are caught in sin gently, paralleling the admonishment in 2 Thessalonians 3:15.

theological.title: 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 2 Thessalonians Chapter 3 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Paul request in 2 Thessalonians 3:1 regarding the word of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Paul requests prayer that the word of the Lord may have free course and be glorified, reflecting its power and importance (2 Thessalonians 3:1).

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:2, why does Paul seek deliverance from wicked men?
options: Because not all men have faith
questions.correctAnswer: Because not all men have faith
questions.explanation: Paul explains that he seeks deliverance from unreasonable and wicked men because all men do not have faith, indicating a challenge the apostles faced (2 Thessalonians 3:2).

questions.question: What attribute of God is highlighted in 2 Thessalonians 3:3?
questions.explanation: The verse emphasizes God's faithfulness, assuring believers that He will establish and protect them from evil (2 Thessalonians 3:3).

questions.question: What does Paul express confidence in regarding the Thessalonians in 2 Thessalonians 3:4?
options: That they will abandon their faith
That they will follow his commands
That they will grow in wealth
questions.correctAnswer: That they will follow his commands
questions.explanation: Paul expresses confidence that the Thessalonians will do and continue to do the things he commands, reflecting his trust in their faithfulness (2 Thessalonians 3:4).

questions.question: According to 2 Thessalonians 3:5, what does Paul pray for the hearts of the believers?
options: That they be filled with knowledge
That they be directed into the love of God
That they be filled with fear
questions.correctAnswer: That they be directed into the love of God
questions.explanation: Paul prays that the Lord directs the hearts of the believers into the love of God, emphasizing the importance of divine love in their lives (2 Thessalonians 3:5).

questions.question: What command does Paul give regarding those who walk disorderly in 2 Thessalonians 3:6?
questions.explanation: Paul commands the believers to withdraw from every brother who walks disorderly and not according to the teachings received, stressing the need for discipline in the church (2 Thessalonians 3:6).

questions.question: In 2 Thessalonians 3:10, what principle does Paul establish regarding work and eating?
options: Those who do not work should not eat
Everyone should eat regardless of work
questions.correctAnswer: Those who do not work should not eat
questions.explanation: Paul establishes the principle that if anyone does not work, they should not eat, underscoring the value of diligent work (2 Thessalonians 3:10).

questions.question: What issue does Paul address about some individuals among the Thessalonians in 2 Thessalonians 3:11?
questions.explanation: Paul addresses the issue that some among the Thessalonians walk disorderly, working not at all, but being busybodies, indicating a lack of responsible behavior (2 Thessalonians 3:11).

questions.question: What does Paul command those who are busybodies to do in 2 Thessalonians 3:12?
questions.explanation: Paul exhorts those who are idle and busybodies to work quietly and eat their own bread, promoting a lifestyle of diligence and responsibility (2 Thessalonians 3:12).

questions.question: What encouragement does Paul give to the brethren in 2 Thessalonians 3:13?
options: To be not weary in well doing
questions.correctAnswer: To be not weary in well doing
questions.explanation: Paul encourages the brethren not to become weary in doing good, affirming the importance of perseverance in righteous actions (2 Thessalonians 3:13).

questions.question: What instruction does Paul give regarding those who do not obey his words in 2 Thessalonians 3:14?
options: To note that man and have no company with him
questions.correctAnswer: To note that man and have no company with him
questions.explanation: Paul instructs that if anyone does not obey his word, they should note him and not associate with him to bring about shame, highlighting the seriousness of obedience (2 Thessalonians 3:14).

questions.question: How does Paul suggest believers should regard those who disobey his command in 2 Thessalonians 3:15?
questions.explanation: Paul instructs that those who are disobedient should not be treated as enemies but admonished as brothers, emphasizing the need for correction in love (2 Thessalonians 3:15).

questions.question: What does Paul pray for the Thessalonians in terms of peace in 2 Thessalonians 3:16?
options: That they have peace through wealth
That the Lord of peace give them peace always by all means
That they find peace in solitude
questions.correctAnswer: That the Lord of peace give them peace always by all means
questions.explanation: Paul prays that the Lord of peace Himself would grant them peace always by all means, reflecting the holistic peace that comes from God (2 Thessalonians 3:16).

questions.question: What is the significance of the salutation in 2 Thessalonians 3:17?
options: It is the first time Paul writes by hand
It serves as a token in every epistle
questions.correctAnswer: It serves as a token in every epistle
questions.explanation: Paul's salutation with his own hand serves as a token in every letter he writes, affirming authenticity and personal connection (2 Thessalonians 3:17).

questions.question: What final blessing does Paul give in 2 Thessalonians 3:18?
options: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
Wealth and prosperity be upon you
questions.correctAnswer: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
questions.explanation: Paul concludes with a blessing that the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the Thessalonians, emphasizing the importance of grace in the Christian life (2 Thessalonians 3:18).
